evidence.title: DesignBookmark, All-in-one design resources for designers

name: DesignBookmark
summary: Directory of 2,500+ design, development and AI tools and resources across 59 categories.
description: DesignBookmark is a searchable directory of design, development and AI tools, websites and resources, organised into 11 groups (Design, AI, Development, No-Code & Web, Marketing & Growth, Productivity, Business, Content & Media, Libraries & Templates, Learn & Community) and 59 categories such as Design Inspiration, Icons, Color & Gradient, Mac Apps, Chrome Extensions, AI Image and Framer Templates. Every tool has a page with a screenshot, description, pricing signal and related alternatives; submissions are free and human-reviewed, and sponsored entries are marked.
contains: largest categories: Design Inspiration 347, Mac Apps 229, APIs & Dev Tools 120
tool pages include screenshot, description, pricing signal and alternatives
